scope: Live-payment launch gate and rollback preparation

current_state.server_registration: api/server.js registers lib/razorpay-payments without overriding paymentsPaused, so the default true hard-pauses live checkout.
current_state.direct_order_probe: POST /api/billing/orders returned HTTP 503 before any valid business credentials or gateway action.
current_state.public_wording: Paid plans are paused/coming soon; free listing remains available.

mandatory_go_live_gates.requirement: Explicit written approval to accept real charges, naming the intended launch date/environment and approved plans.
Task 10 decisions completed and consistently published: operator, support, plan terms, taxes/invoices, cancellation/refund rules and merchant identity.
Task 11 returns schemaReady=true on the identified Neon production database and required permissions/constraints are separately verified.
All eight Task 12 cases pass with test credentials, real test webhook delivery and an authorised approved business test record.
Founder confirms Razorpay merchant/KYC activation, settlement bank, customer-facing merchant name/descriptor and live webhook ownership.
Named support owner, failed/duplicate payment procedure, refund procedure, reconciliation cadence, alerting and incident rollback are approved.

After every prior gate passes, review a minimal change that explicitly opts the production registration out of paymentsPaused, test it in a protected release, and obtain final founder approval before production promotion.

credential_rules: Test and live credentials remain separate.
Secrets are entered directly in provider settings, never chat, browser code, GitHub or logs.
The live webhook secret must match the separately configured Razorpay live webhook.
A credential-presence check is not payment acceptance evidence.
release_sequence: Confirm merchant activation and operating runbook.
Deploy a reviewed release with live credentials still unable to charge.
Run read-only configuration and policy checks.
Apply the minimal hard-pause opt-out and deploy.
Verify /api/billing/config reports mode=live without creating an order.
Run one separately authorised controlled real-payment acceptance case only if the founder explicitly approves that charge.
Monitor and retain the ability to restore paymentsPaused immediately.

rollback.action: Restore the hard pause in server registration and redeploy; remove/disable live checkout configuration in Vercel/Razorpay as appropriate.
rollback.data_rule: Do not delete payment ledger rows during rollback; reconcile existing orders and refunds through the approved operations process.

explicitly_not_done: No live credentials retrieved or configured
No real order, charge or refund
No legal or refund policy invented
